subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Is the current source proof that WhatsApp still suppresses final error payloads enough to keep this issue open despite the merged run-lifecycle stack?
rationale: The run-lifecycle side is partly fixed on main, but the concrete WhatsApp delivery suppression remains and the related cross-channel contract is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Keep open for WhatsApp proof
options.body: Track this issue until the WhatsApp adapter delivers or explicitly fails sanitized final fallback text, then verify with live or source-level proof.

options.title: Fold into the contract issue
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers intentionally make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 the sole tracker and preserve the WhatsApp production evidence there.

options.title: Treat run-lifecycle as sufficient
options.body: Close after accepting that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102160 is enough, despite the remaining WhatsApp adapter suppression source path.

recommendation.title: Keep open for WhatsApp proof
recommendation.body: Track this issue until the WhatsApp adapter delivers or explicitly fails sanitized final fallback text, then verify with live or source-level proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision overlaps the maintainer-authored durable final fallback contract issue.
